shown.message:
I closed `paper-repo`#3. The paper's reproducibility notes and the checklist will state the encounter with the reserved paper's README exactly as experiment-repo recorded it. That means what it was, where it was, that about 80 lines were read once, that none of it was used to choose methods, splits or the primary endpoint, and that the independence of those choices can't be verified.

Venue-repo still hasn't replied to `venue-repo`#3, so the template is still missing and I'm waiting on it. figtab-repo has pushed Fig. 1 (`figures/fig1_protocol.pdf`) to `dev`. Experiment-repo has pushed its data audit, protocol and reproducibility notes, but it has no results yet.
